artifact_observations.reasoning: The yarn texture on the crocheted items is slightly soft and lacks the crisp definition of individual fibers seen in high-resolution macro photography. Some stitches blend together slightly, typical of AI generation struggling with fine repetitive textures.

The painted floral pattern on the lower part of the mug wraps around the cylinder but shows very slight inconsistency in perspective curvature compared to the rigid geometry of the cup. It's subtle but noticeable upon close inspection.

The spout of the teapot under the cozy is vaguely defined. The transition between the cozy's opening and the implied spout is blurry and lacks clear structural logic, appearing somewhat melted into the fabric.
